title: Gigabyte B850 Aorus Stealth ATX Motherboard $292.20 + Delivery (Free with > $300 Spend) @ Pbtech
body:
Deal: Gigabyte B850 Aorus Stealth ATX Motherboard $292.20 + Delivery (Free with > $300 Spend) @ Pbtech

[dmski] 5GbE instead of just 10GbE is strange otherwise seems pretty solid considering CPU costs have been pretty stellar (relatively). I'm almost tempted to buy part by part over a few months when lucky deals hit..
[netsurfer] Another annoying bit is using RTL8922AE for WiFi 7. That chipset only supports 160MHz channel width. That is not true / proper WiFi 7.
Two PCIe gen 5 x4 m.2/NVMe SSD slots + Two PCIe gen 4 x4 NVMe SSD slots is a nice combo though.
[JURBA] you have to find a compatible pc case for this that supports the back connectors on it i read
[filfa] Form factor yes, but all the headers are on the rear of the motherboard which requires a compatible case.
[Water Bearer] They call them BTF (back to front) motherboards. All the connectors are on the underside of the board, so it makes it easier to hide all the cabling.
Motherboards usually screw into a section thats closed off and you can't access the back of the board in most cases, so thats why people will need to find a certain case that will allow it.
[spackbace] I built the Mrs a new pc recently with the V100R. Good value for money, takes full ATX boards and comes with 4 Lian-Li fans 🙂
[panda1010101] +1 for Phanteks G400A. Fits ATX mobos and supports 360mm radiator. Comes with 4x140mm fans
[filfa] I just built the MATX in a Cooler Master MasterFrame 400, could try the 500?
[Water Bearer] Try searching for BTF motherboard cases. You'll have a lot more options come up that will have access for back to front style
[xintis] Finally a black one!!!!! Most of the RC Mobos have been white and I got the Fractal North XL Case in black ( https://www.pbtech.com/au/product/CHAFRD0059/Fractal-Design-… )
and it was so bloody annoying to have a white Mobo. I'll be buying this one.
[Nom] And only 2 PCIe slots too, full size ATX is super weird for such a limited spec.
[netsurfer] It's due to wanting to 2x PCIe gen 4 x4 NVMe SSD slots via the chipset. There is only so much chipset lanes available. It also has 2x PCIe gen 5 x4 NVMe SSD slots. You might consider this board if you want a board to support 4 NVMe SSDs.
It is not an ATX board that provides flexibility by giving you more PCIe slots and let you choose what you want to do with them.
[JROX20] Given the emphasis is on aesthetics this makes sense to me. NVMe drives concealed beneath a shiny heatsink are visually more appealing than a PCIe card to house additional drives. I accept your point that flexibility is lost in this regard.
[gegagedigedagedago] AI has been so hungry it's now stealing SATA connectors.
[edfoo] Need good deals on RAM and SSD to go with this…
And don't forget GPU too.
[likeawagon] Does this have any SATA connections for older HDD's or a disc drive?
[BlitzR] Here is a decent review on this board (Ice version) . He pokes fun at how it's literally the same as the Aorus x870 stealth, the vrm layout, usb4, RGB…
https://youtu.be/ZIkpZpwq6n4
